source.book: Walker, Manual of Needlework and Cutting Out (1909)

rights: Published 1909, public domain in the US. Drafting methods are uncopyrightable (project policy). The outlines are traced from the book's cutting-out diagrams and set onto its printed figures by ccat (tracing pattern geometry is fair use, project policy).

status.construction: traced cutting-out diagram, set onto the printed figures
status.note: Front and back of the man's night-shirt, cut on the lines (turnings included), with the front opening as a slit and notches where the side seams end (vents below). Not yet complete: the sleeves, wrist bands, yoke and lining, collars and gussets are on p. 236 and aren't built. Not test-sewn. The book's figures were transcribed by hand for this first Walker garment (no figure reader yet); the shapes are traced from the drawing and set onto those figures.

export.seam_allowance_basis: the source's cut line: the book's diagrams give the cloth to cut, turnings included
export.darts: cut edge runs straight across the dart mouth (caps not trued); drill hole 1 cm short of the apex
